data.name: Greater Cognatogen
data.description: Your mutagen now grants a +4 natural armor bonus, a +6 alchemical bonus to one mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma), and a +4 alchemical bonus to a second mental ability score. You take a -2 penalty on both associated physical ability scores as long as the mutagen persists, and take 2 points of ability damage to both associated physical ability scores when the cognatogen ends.
